## Recovered observations

26 points (from FB-7) read by two readings made separately and reconciled (batch `curves-appb-b1`, rules `docs/CURVE-READING.md (2026-10-08)`). Values are SI; the printed-unit values and the pixel coordinates on the page image are kept beside them so every point can be checked against the scan. x_read_bound and y_read_bound are reading bounds in printed units: the largest change of value over the point's pixel interval on the piecewise map, plus the location error of the two lines around it (D-025; the global calibration residual is not added, see qa/<batch>/calibration-sensitivity.md for the affine difference); x_bound_si and y_bound_si are the same in SI. They are not standard deviations.

Both readings drawn on the page image (filled circles: Claude's reading; hollow squares: Codex's; bars: pixel bounds; the canonical reading of each panel is named in the batch review). Click to enlarge.

## Notes from the two readings

- Claude: Label sits on the lower drawn line; filled circles presumably this group (not keyed). A-79 cites Dr 0.77 tests giving 5,000 to 6,000 psi at 4 psi and estimates 4000 psi for soil 10 (not measured). Text 2-3: LSM results may be questionable; low permeability gave a pressure gradient along the specimen so the effective confining pressure could not be determined. One specimen per printed Dr assumed (text 2: several measurements on each sample at different confining pressures); paired markers at one pressure may be repeat shots.
- Codex: Density group with repeated stress-wave measurements; E = ρc²; no Poisson correction. Specimen dimensions and pulse duration missing. Effective confining pressure could not be determined because of a pressure gradient; number of specimens not stated. AM-68-1 Vol. II, Fig. 7, printed 10, PDF 113
